text.p: Centigram Communications Corp said Wednesday it has entered into a letter of intent for the acquisition of Voice-Tel Enterprises and its unit Voice-Tel Network.
Voice-Tel has more than $30 million in annual revenues, provides voice messaging and voice processing services to more than 500,000 subscribers in North America, Australia and New Zealand.
The deal, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval, would involve the issuance of some 2.3 million shares of Centigram common stock, and would be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

The exact number of shares would be adjusted downward if the closing price of Centigram stock during the five trading days before the Centigram stockholder meeting, called to approve the definitive agreement, exceeds $20 per share. If Centigram stock price is less than $10 per share during the measurement period, either Centigram or Voice-Tel would be able to elect not to consummate the transaction.
Centigram would also assume up to $11.5 million of outstanding debt of Voice-Tel. The deal is expected to close within three months.
